exclude_applications.title: Excluded applications
exclude_applications.description: Applications to leave unmonitored, using the exact discovered names shown in Java applications. Leave empty to monitor all eligible applications.

application_names.title: Display names
application_names.description: Optional display names keyed by discovered application name. Leave empty to keep the discovered names; changing a display name preserves application identity.

exclude_applications.ui:help: Excluding an application stops new attachment and metric publication. Instrumentation already loaded into a running JVM remains until that application restarts.
